buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 3. Service & Support AVAILABILITY OF OFFICE OF SERVICE PROVIDER: An office of the Service Provider must be located in the state of Consignee. DOCUMENTARY EVIDENCE TO BE SUBMITTED. 4. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any.

5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bid Schedule 1.1. The bid opening and closing period shall be 10 days. 1.2. The bid cycle (validity period from the date of publishing) shall be 85 days 2. Eligibility of Bidders 2.1. The bidder must be a registered legal entity in India and must possess valid registration with the tax authorities. 2.2. The bidder must attach copies of valid PAN and GST registration certificates with the bid. 2.3. The bidder must have a geographical presence in the state of consignee i.e . Chandigarh. The Firm Should have registered address of Chandigarh. 3. Statutory Compliance and Affidavits 3.1. The bidder shall upload an undertaking in the form of an affidavit, or a certi ficate from the competent authority, confirming non-default in the deposit of st atutory contributions such as EPF, ESI, and GST during the last three financial y ears. 3.2. The bidder shall submit a duly attested affidavit (by an Executive Magistrat e declaring the following: 3.2.1 That the bidder/service provider has never been declared bankrupt, insolv ent, or placed under liquidation by any financial institution or court of law. 3.2.2 That the bidder/service provider has an unblemished record and has neve r been blacklisted by any Central/State Government, PSU, University, Education al Institution, or any court of law 3.2.3 That the bidder accepts all terms and conditions of the tender, including t hese Additional Terms & Conditions and the Scope of Work. 4. Experience and Financial Criteria 4.1 The service provider must have a minimum of three (3) years of experience in providing manpower services. 4.2 The bidder shall attach a certificate from a statutory auditor/Chartered Acco untant (CA) indicating the average annual turnover for the last three financial y ears (2023–24, 2024–25,and 2025–26), which shall be as per the requirement s pecified in this bid document. 4.3 The bidder must also submit a valid Labour Department Registration Certifi cate (Form-F) issued by the Labour Department, Chandigarh. 5. Duration and Extension of Contract

5.1 The total duration of the service contract shall be as specified in the bid do cument. 5.2 The contract may be extended for a further period of up to Six month beyo nd the initial contract period, subject to satisfactory performance and mutual co n sent of both parties. 6. Payment and Wage Disbursement 6.1 The service provider shall be responsible for timely payment of wages to the deployed contractual staff as per applicable DC rates fixed by the Chandigarh A dministration from time to time 6.2 Payment of wages must be accompanied by statutory compliance document s such as EPF, ESI , and GST challans. 6.3 The service provider must submit a bank statement showing salary disburse ment to the deployed staff before the 7th of every month 6.4 Bills for payment shall be raised only after submission of proof of wage disb ursement and statutory payments. 6.5 The service provider shall be solely responsible for the timely deposit of stat utory dues (EPF, ESI, GST etc.) and any penalty for late submission shall be born e by the contractor. 6.6 Applicable TDS deductions under the Income Tax Act and GST Act shall appl y. 6.7 Payment of wages to workers shall not be linked to the release of pending bi lls by the Department. The service provider must have sufficient funds to cover at least three months salary of the deployed staff in advance without payment being released from department. 7. Deployment of Existing Resources 7.1 The number of existing manpower deployed under the current contract shall continue under the new contract, subject to their willingness to work under the revised terms and conditions and their eligibility criteria. 7.2 The service provider shall not replace existing staff without prior written con sent of the Buyer/ Department. 8. Variation in Quantity 8.1 The purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the required manp

ower by up to 50% during the contract period. 8.2 The bidder shall be bound to accept such variations on the same terms and conditions. 9. Employee Documentation and Identification 9.1 The educational qualifications of outsourced manpower shall conform to the minimum qualifications (Which is High School/ in this case) applicable on their o riginal date of joining 9.2 The service provider shall furnish complete employee documentation, includ ing educational certificates, Aadhaar card, PAN card, Experience Certificate, etc ., at the time of deployment. 9.3 The ID cards of all deployed staff shall be issued by the service provider at it s own cost. No reimbursement or claim for ID cards shall be entertained by the Department. 10. Blacklisting and Penalties 10.1 The purchaser reserves the right to blacklist the firm for a period of up to t hree (3) years in case of failure, default, or breach of contract terms and conditi ons. 10.2 A reasonable opportunity of hearing shall be provided to the bidder be fore issuing any blacklisting order. 11. Precedence of Conditions 11.1 In the event of any conflict between the GeM portal in-built terms & conditi ons and these Additional Terms & Conditions, the Additional Terms Conditions ( ATC) shall prevail 12.Agency shall not demand any payment, registration fee or any kind of extorti on from the employees deployed under this contract. 13. Bidder has to deploy existing staff, as per notification of Chandigarh adminis tration. 14. EMD Submission is compulsory for all bidder, no exemption is given to the M SME Registration. 15. The Bidder should have a PASRA Certificate issued from Chandigarh Administration. .
